name: maxwell-wait-gap-pilot-v1
claim: A state grounded from past boundary observations can evolve through separation and recovery to predict recontact under unseen wait durations.
unit_of_analysis: complete episode; ID/OOD are paired by unseen history

splits.name: test_id
splits.held_out: independent complete histories; waits in training ranges
splits.leakage_check: disjoint episode IDs and saved SHA256

splits.name: test_wait
splits.held_out: waits in [0.8,1.2] s; train waits [0.2,0.5] or [1.8,2.2] s
splits.leakage_check: same test histories, never training histories; equal forecast duration

baselines.name: gru_force
baselines.category: unstructured material memory with matched actuator physics

metrics.name: recontact_force_rmse_N
metrics.rationale: Mean per-episode RMSE within 1.2 s of commanded repress onset, excludes long easy zero-force waits

falsification_criteria: Material-state model does not beat its frozen/reset-state variants on held-out wait prediction.
Snapshot model matches history model: this dataset does not establish necessity of historical grounding.
Classical correct-family estimator matches or beats learned models: no learned-law advantage may be claimed on this generator.
scope: Held-out wait INTERPOLATION inside training min/max. One homogeneous material, one known impedance. No real-world or new-material result.
additional_diagnostic: paired wait-effect prediction error, synchronized to commanded repress onset
statistical_plan: 1500 hierarchical bootstrap resamples of optimization seeds and independent paired test episodes; seed-wise means retained. Deterministic classical models bootstrap episodes only.
training_information: Noisy x,v,F,u,dt histories and noisy future x,F labels. Known relaxed physical initial condition. No ground-truth material state supervision.
test_information: Noisy past, current x/v, future commands; future achieved positions/forces are labels only. Oracle separately marked.
prospective_snapshot_note: Snapshot ablation added before any test-set evaluation to assess whether the history encoder is necessary. Same 330-update plan as the main two models.
